Not listed in the official requirements.
Your highest diploma, or proof of expected graduation. If you send proof of expected graduation, give the formal diploma before registration (BLCU).
Official transcript of your highest completed education, with every semester (BLCU). Degree programmes only.
Not listed for non-degree (one-year, one-semester, four-week) programmes in the official requirements.
Scans of your HSK and HSKK score reports, valid for two years. The minimum scores depend on the programme and level.
A reference letter from the head of your recommending institution (for example a Confucius Institute, HSK centre, school or embassy).
The head-of-institution letter plus two reference letters from professors or associate professors.
The head-of-institution letter plus two reference letters from professors, associate professors or experts with equivalent titles in the field.
A valid CSCA score report (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) obtained before the application deadline (BLCU 2026 guide).
BLCU asks for a study plan of over 800 Chinese characters (CV, education, Chinese level, research ability, research proposal, career plan). Other host universities may differ.
Personal statement of about 3,000 words in Chinese, covering your intended field of study and a research proposal.
BLCU asks for an acceptance letter from a supervisor in your field. Other host universities may differ.
Only for in-service Chinese language teachers: proof of employment and a reference letter from your employer.
Only if you are under 18: a notarised guardianship statement from a guardian living in China (BLCU).
